conceptual_change: Introduce a mean-reversion filter identifying price divergence from the 50-period rolling mean price using a z-score of the distance from the mean to signal potential exhaustion.
rationale: Statistical arbitrage relies on mean reversion between correlated assets. By using a z-score of the price relative to its rolling mean, we can identify when a specific asset has deviated significantly from its recent local equilibrium, suggesting a statistical correction.
